title: 29:5 multitude of her strangers shall be like small dust. The multitude, mentioned twice in this verse, refers to the nations that destroyed Jerusalem in the past (including Babylon, Rome, and all others who laid siege against her; 29:3) or who will fight against Jerusalem in the future. These once-mighty nations will suffer the judgments of God and become like the fine dust of the earth.
author: Tina M. Peterson
